The dual-gate buffer expanded to 115 points (SPX 7,575.39), VIX compressed to 15.84, and DAL confirmed travel-demand resilience with a Q2 beat. HOLD is maintained—not upgraded to BUY—because Trump declared the ceasefire 'OVER' on July 10 with Hormuz tanker traffic 'effectively grinding to a halt' per Al Jazeera, introducing a 2-4 week oil-supply shock lag that could spike WTI above $85 and blow through the CPI forecast range. With the regime binary (June CPI) four days away, holding the gate-authorized positions without adding gross exposure is the correct posture.

bear_case: The session's most important signal may be the one the bulls are ignoring: DAL reported an earnings beat — stronger revenue, reaffirmed guidance — and fell 4%. This is a market pricing maximum perfection into each print and punishing anything short of a clear acceleration. If DAL's sell-the-news pattern at a record-fuel-expense quarter is the template for Q2 reporting season, then NVDA's full-size add protocol completing on July 10 and August 26 becoming the key event creates a 6-week window where the stock needs to hold $200+ without a fundamental catalyst — in a macro environment where Hormuz tanker traffic is 'effectively grinding to a halt' (Al Jazeera), Trump has declared the ceasefire 'OVER,' and the Cleveland Fed's June CPI nowcast is ~4%. The oil disruption lag is the critical mechanism: if Hormuz tanker clearance has stalled since Tuesday (July 7), US crude inventories will reflect the supply gap by late July, pushing WTI back above $80 and reigniting the inflation expectations that CPI July 14 cannot yet show. A hot CPI print (≥4.0%) combined with a Hormuz-driven WTI spike above $80 would produce a rapid regime reversal: September hike becomes base case, 30Y pushes toward 5.35%, AI multiples compress, and the dual-gate floor at 7,460 — currently 115 points below — becomes the key support to watch. Counter-argument invalidation: if CPI July 14 prints ≤3.5% AND a back-channel Iran ceasefire is announced before July 17, the HOLD upgrades to BUY at high conviction and the gate-authorized positions are confirmed. If SPX closes below 7,460 or VIX closes above 17 before July 14, the regime reverts to BEARISH regardless of SKHYV or NVDA price action.
